aboutGame.title: What is MR. RECORDS?
paragraphs: MR. RECORDS is a rhythm adventure and record shop management game from developer Glee-Cheese Studio and publisher Wired Productions. You play as George, who runs a record shop by day and steps into surreal, music-driven platforming stages by night, where every record you sell or collect opens the door to another memory.

The game pairs cozy shopkeeping with rhythm-based running, jumping, sliding, and dodging across more than 40 handcrafted levels. Alongside George is his dog Buzz and a cast of regular customers whose stories, photographs, and notes unfold as you build the collection, with an original soundtrack tying the shop and the stage together.

modules.name: MR. RECORDS Beginner Guide
modules.description: Explain the core gameplay loop for new players, including running the record shop, learning customer preferences, unlocking records, and entering rhythm journeys. This module should provide a clear starting path without relying on advanced progression knowledge.

highlights.detail: Open the shop and greet your first customers at the counter.
Read each request and recommend a record that fits the mood.
Drop the needle on a record to start a rhythm journey.
Run, jump, and slide in time with the music to clear the stage.
Collect the memories, photos, and notes each stage unlocks.
Reinvest your earnings and repeat the loop with new records.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about MR. RECORDS.

items.question: What is MR. RECORDS?
items.answer: MR. RECORDS is a rhythm adventure and record shop management game from Glee-Cheese Studio and Wired Productions. You run George's record shop by day and play music-driven platforming stages by night.

items.question: What platforms is MR. RECORDS on?
items.answer: MR. RECORDS is announced for PC, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch 2, with a free Steam demo already available.

items.question: Is there a free demo of MR. RECORDS?
items.answer: Yes. The MR. RECORDS demo launched on Steam on September 22, 2026, and lets you try both the record shop and the rhythm stages before launch.

items.question: How many levels does MR. RECORDS have?
items.answer: MR. RECORDS features more than 40 handcrafted levels that mix running, jumping, sliding, and rhythm-based action.

items.question: What languages does MR. RECORDS support?
items.answer: MR. RECORDS supports 11 languages, including English, Japanese, Spanish, and Korean.
